item.title: Release: EPUB Reader for Anbernic RG280v
item.description:
A few days ago I saw a youtube video about a tiny e-ink reader and why it is very practical (one hand operation, etc). Next to me, I had my Anbernic RG280V which I bought precisely because of how tiny and yet usable it is.

Two of my favorite features on the RG280V are that its screen can go very dark and you can play games that don’t require quick reactions (such as JRPGs) with one hand!
